Healthcare / Project breakdown

Bedaya Health

A healthcare platform with an established search presence, but room to turn its existing exposure into more organic clicks. The project combined search-result presentation, structured data and mobile experience improvements.

bedayaccpa.comGoogle Search Console3-month comparison

In this case studyThe starting pointThe approachResults & evidenceWhat changedThe takeaway
01 / The challenge

The starting point.

Bedaya Health started with 53.6K clicks, 2.76M impressions and a 1.9% CTR over three months. I focused on how its medical pages appeared in search and how they loaded on mobile.

02 / The approach

What the work involved.

  1. Improve the search-result message

    I rewrote titles and meta descriptions to show what each medical page covered.

  2. Add relevant structured data

    I added MedicalWebPage and FAQ structured data to describe the content on relevant pages.

  3. Address the mobile experience

    I worked on Largest Contentful Paint and Cumulative Layout Shift to improve loading and layout stability on mobile.

03 / The evidence

Before & after.

Google Search Console compares two consecutive three-month periods.

04 / Reading the result

What the numbers tell us.

Over the later three-month period, clicks reached 109K (+103%) and impressions reached 5.06M. CTR rose from 1.9% to 2.1%, and average position improved from 8.5 to 8.1.

05 / The takeaway

What this project shows.

The project combined changes to search snippets, structured data and the mobile experience across key medical pages.
